name: hcapp_approveLogin
description: Main app launch / login SP called on every app startup after initial device authorization. Validates the device auth token, records the login event, updates device metadata, checks for server notifications and unseen splash screens, and returns session configuration from HC.ServerStatus.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID as a string. Compared against Device.id.
parameters.typeMismatch: Should be UNIQUEIDENTIFIER to match Device.id — using NVARCHAR(100) bypasses type safety and forces implicit conversion.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token. Validated via HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 using the Device.DeviceSecret (uppercased) and Device.TimeWindow.

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Device model string (e.g. 'iPhone 6s / iOS 11.4'). Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin only.

parameters.name: deviceName
parameters.description: User-assigned device name. Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin only.

parameters.name: systemName
parameters.description: OS name (e.g. 'iOS', 'Android'). Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin and Device via DeviceData.

parameters.name: systemVersion
parameters.description: OS version string. Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin only.

parameters.name: manufacturer
parameters.description: Device manufacturer (e.g. 'Apple', 'Samsung'). Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin only.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Device GPS latitude. Stored on Device and LaunchAndLogin.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Device GPS longitude. Stored on Device and LaunchAndLogin.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version string. Default 'pre 0.6.4'. Stored on Hasher.HcVersion and Device.Version.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(200) vs Hasher.HcVersion NVARCHAR(50) and Device.Version NVARCHAR(25). Silent truncation possible.

parameters.name: buildNumber
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) vs Device.BuildNumber NVARCHAR(25). Silent truncation possible.

parameters.name: fbToken
parameters.description: Facebook access token. Accepted but the update logic that used it is fully commented out. Dead parameter in current code.

parameters.name: usesLocSvcs
parameters.description: Whether the user permits location services. Default -1. Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin only.

parameters.name: screenWidth
parameters.description: Device screen width in pixels. Default 0. Accepted but never used — dead input.

parameters.name: screenHeight
parameters.description: Device screen height in pixels. Default 0. Accepted but never used — dead input.

parameters.name: ipInfo
parameters.description: IP address / geolocation string. Stored in HC.LaunchAndLogin only.

parameters.name: splashSequenceViewed
parameters.description: Timestamp when the user viewed a splash screen. If not null, a SplashSequenceViews record is inserted. Default null.

parameters.name: splashSequenceRootName
parameters.description: Root name of the splash sequence the user just viewed. Used with @splashSequenceViewed to mark it as seen. Default null.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Device locale string. Default ''. Stored on Device.Locale.

rowsets.name: RemovedUserError
rowsets.description: Returned when the resolved user's Removed flag = 1. Checked BEFORE the access token, so a removed user sees this error regardless of token validity. Uses near-standard error format.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Always 5. Should be 3 per HC standards.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing removal message with next steps.

columns.name: debugMessage
columns.description: Always 'This is a standard error that is anticipated and does not require debugging'.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 fails. SP does NOT return immediately — it still executes the LaunchAndLogin INSERT (marking it as an invalid-token event) before returning. Uses near-standard error format.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing message directing user to support.

columns.name: debugMessage
columns.description: 'This could be an indication that there is an error in the code...'.

rowsets.name: LoginResult
rowsets.description: Returned on successful authentication. Pulled from HC.ServerStatus (TOP 1 by CreatedDate desc) with additional computed fields. Integration-related columns (integrationCount, lastIntegrationExecuted, integrationStopped) are hardcoded to stub values — the CTE that calculated them is computed but then overridden.

columns.name: approvalCode
columns.description: 0 if serverStatusCode != 1 (server down), else 1 (approved). Hardcoded logic.

columns.name: loginMessageTitle
columns.description: LoginNotifications.LoginMessageTitle or 'Harrier Central Message' if none active.

columns.name: loginMessage
columns.description: LoginNotifications.LoginMessage or 'Server running' if none active.

columns.name: imageRootUrl
columns.description: ServerStatus.ImageRootUrl — base URL for user-uploaded images.

columns.name: homeKennelId
columns.description: Hasher.HomeKennelId — returned as nvarchar because @homeKennelId is declared as nvarchar(100) not uniqueidentifier.

columns.name: thirdPartyForceTokenRefresh
columns.description: Hasher.ThirdPartyForceTokenRefresh — signals app to refresh OAuth token.

columns.name: integrationCount
columns.description: Hardcoded to 0. The CTE that calculated active integration failures is computed but its result is ignored.

columns.name: splashSequenceRootName
columns.description: Root name of the next unseen splash sequence for this user, or null if none pending.

columns.name: splashSequenceType
columns.description: SplashSequence.SequenceType of the pending splash, or null.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.LaunchAndLogin — always, even on auth failure (with errorInfo = 'Invalid Access Token')
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on removed user and auth failure paths
INSERT HC.SplashSequenceViews — if @splashSequenceViewed is not null
UPDATE HC.Hasher SET LastLoginDateTime, HcVersion WHERE id = @userId — on success only
UPDATE HC.Device SET LastLogin, Latitude, Longitude, updatedAt, BuildNumber, Version, Locale WHERE id = @deviceId — on success only

codeSmells.detail: All other app SPs use UNIQUEIDENTIFIER for @deviceId to match Device.id. Using NVARCHAR(100) forces an implicit string comparison, bypasses type safety, and could silently misroute lookups if case or format differs.

codeSmells.issue: Removed-user check precedes auth check — information disclosure
codeSmells.detail: The removed-user check runs before CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2. A caller with an invalid token but a removed user's deviceId gets a 'user removed' error rather than 'invalid token'. This discloses account status to unauthenticated callers.

codeSmells.issue: Dead CTE — integration data calculated then hardcoded over
codeSmells.detail: A CTE computes integrationCount/lastIntegrationExecuted/integrationStopped from HC.Kennel join, but the SELECT that outputs these values hardcodes them to 0/2100/0. The CTE runs on every login for nothing.

@deviceSecret = upper(d.DeviceSecret) — the raw DeviceSecret stored in HC.Device is uppercase-forced before passing to CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2. If the secret contains lowercase letters (possible given the base64 generation in hcapp_authorizeDevice), this changes the value and could cause validation mismatches. Must verify CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 is tolerant of this.
@screenWidth (SMALLINT) and @screenHeight (SMALLINT) are accepted but never read or used anywhere in the SP body.

@fbToken is accepted, possibly overwritten from Hasher.FacebookAccessToken in the SELECT, but all code that would use it to update Hasher or Kennel is commented out. The value is inserted into HC.LaunchAndLogin? No — LaunchAndLogin INSERT has no fbToken column. Entirely dead.
@hcVersion NVARCHAR(200) vs Hasher.HcVersion NVARCHAR(50) and Device.Version NVARCHAR(25). @buildNumber NVARCHAR(50) vs Device.BuildNumber NVARCHAR(25). Silent truncation on long values.

Hasher.HomeKennelId is UNIQUEIDENTIFIER but is read into a local @homeKennelId nvarchar(100) variable and returned as such. Format will match but type is wrong throughout — should be UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

codeSmells.issue: Wrong errorType for removed user — 5 instead of 3
codeSmells.detail: errorType=5 ('Unhandled database error') used for anticipated removed-user business case. Should be 3.
Auth failure returns errorType=1, which is not in the HC standard errorType table. Should be 3.
No error handling. Unhandled exceptions surface as raw SQL errors to the caller.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
Never change the serverStatusCode values without updating all callers
